name: Inverted‑L Antenna
description: The Inverted‑L is a compact HF antenna consisting of a vertical section and a horizontal top wire. It provides excellent low‑band performance when space is limited and is widely used for 160m, 80m, and 40m operation.
modelingNotes: Vertical section provides low‑angle radiation for DX.
Horizontal section increases electrical length and tuning flexibility.
Ground losses dominate performance on low HF bands.
Radial count and length strongly affect efficiency.
Current distribution is modeled along both vertical and horizontal legs.
End effects shorten the required physical wire length.
